Summarize the current state of project documentation.

Check each documentation area and report:
- `docs/design/conceptual/` — what exists, what's missing
- `docs/design/logical/` — what exists, what's missing
- `docs/design/physical/` — what exists, what's missing
- `docs/requirements/` — what exists, what's missing
- `docs/decisions/` — what exists, what's missing
- `components/` — which components have READMEs

List any documentation gaps or staleness issues. Keep the report concise.
